label: iris-waitlist-flow
notes: Waitlist checks ran at 1024x768, the admin minimum width in docs/ui/10-UI-UX規格.md section 3.
Three windows: counter desk A (COUNTER), desk B (MANAGER) and the call display opened from desk A.
The seat request was held with page.route only to test the busy guard; the real backend response was then delivered.
One overdue ticket had called_at moved back 11 minutes with SQL; the display was refreshed once because SQL changes send no push.
Route checks visit 15 existing customer and admin pages at 1440px/390px and fail on page errors or API 5xx.
